content_zh:
宁小凡暗自思量，口中道：“那我就不客气了！”
“慢。”魏青衫止住他，疑惑重重道：“小友，你……不会想用针灸救治病人吧？”
“有什么问题吗？”
“何止有问题，简直荒谬啊！哎，你师傅难道没告诉过你，针灸只能作为辅助治疗，怎可大张旗鼓用于主治呢？”
魏青衫眼中闪过失望之色，摇头不已，这与他的认知简直背道而驰。
“魏老行医六十余载，救人无数，经验不是你能比拟的，你就别胡闹了。”楚海山也是严肃皱眉，在他看来，宁小凡学艺不深。
“针灸不可用于主治？”宁小凡眉头一掀，冷傲道：“那我今天就让你们见识见识，针灸的威力！”
说完，他右手凌空一掀，翻滚的气流，从盒底神乎其技地带起一根冰魄银针。
下一刻，宁小凡写意般的屈指一弹，银针撞击在指尖，化作一道冰蓝色的流光，不偏不倚，正中楚惜颜眉心。
“你找死！！”
楚海山见宁小凡如此放肆，目光陡然凶狠起来。
“奇了！奇了！”
就在这时，魏青衫惊奇地大声叫喊，眼中布满惊惧。
楚海山回过头，只见床上的楚惜颜剧烈咳嗽起来，大量黑色的淤血从她口鼻中咳出，浸湿了床单。
“惜颜！”
楚海山面露狂喜，如一阵风刮到床边，抱紧了楚惜颜，眼中流出滚烫的泪水。
“太好了，惜颜，我的女儿……你没事了！”
“爸……我这是怎么了。”
楚惜颜面色苍白，虚弱不堪。
“是宁小凡救了你！”顿时，楚海山表情惭愧起来，他刚才好像还骂人家来着。

“小凡？”
楚惜颜眼中闪过惊讶，抬起头，只看见床边站着宁小凡和一个精神矍铄的老者。
“嘿嘿，楚大校花，你现在感觉怎么样？”
宁小凡笑着问道。
“有点难受，不过已经好多了……宁小凡，真的是你救了我吗？”楚惜颜不可思议的看向他。
“海山啊，能遇到宁小友真是你的福气……”
魏青衫自嘲般的笑了笑，“如此神鬼叵测的针法，我老头子今天算是见识到了，就算比起那中海鹤山上的医圣，恐怕也不逞多让！”
“恕老朽多嘴问一句，宁小友，你这手神针师从何人啊？”
“我师傅常年云游四海，神龙见尾不见首的，不提也罢。”宁小凡胡乱扯道。
“这才是高人。”
魏青衫显然被唬住了。
正在这时，楚惜颜忽然发出一声惊叫！
“啊！你……你是谁？！”
三人一震，只见躺在病床上的楚惜颜，玉指死死指着窗台上，像是见到了什么异常恐怖的事物，吓得小脸白如薄纸。
“惜颜！惜颜你怎么了？”
楚海山忙上前抱住女儿，转头望去，窗台上除了窗帘和盆栽，什么都没有，可楚惜颜却吓得大呼小叫。
“魏老，小凡，惜颜这是……”楚海山刚松懈下去的神经，再次紧绷了起来。
魏青衫也是一脸懵逼，他心想：不会是刚才针灸的时候，宁小凡用力过猛，把人脑袋治坏了吧？
宁小凡眉头紧锁，想了想后，他走上前去，攥紧窗帘，用力一撕。
白色的窗帘被撕下一角，宁小凡拿到水池边浸湿，又咬破食指，在白布上写着什么……

魏青衫和楚海山面面相觑，谁也不知道宁小凡在做什么。
“天眼，启！”
宁小凡将白布，凌空一抛，右手掐住剑指，遥遥一指！
接下来的一幕，将两人顿时吓得亡魂皆冒！
只见那原本空荡荡的窗台边，有一个尖嘴猴腮、白衣白帽的老太太坐在那里，彷如从空气里钻出来，眼睛阴恻恻地望着几人。
白衣老太浑身煞气逼人，眼神更是阴毒无比，只望一眼，便如坠冰窖。
“鬼啊！！”
楚海山第一个叫了起来，饶是掌管数百亿财富的大集团董事长，也没见过如此恐怖瘆人的一幕。
魏青衫更是吓得老脸惨白，动都不敢动一下。
只有宁小凡平静地望着那个白衣老太太。
“桀桀桀，想不到你个小娃娃，居然会开天眼……道家七十二脉，我黄三太奶倒也识得不少，你师承哪一脉？”
白衣老太的声音晦涩低哑，就跟磨玻璃般难听。
“黄三太奶？”
听到对方道号，宁小凡心中一凛，这下完了，惹上大麻烦了！
“桀桀，你不说，奶奶也懒得问。”
黄三太奶阴冷笑道：“不过此事，乃是我与楚家人的恩怨，我奉劝你，切勿参与进来……

content_en:
Ning Xiaofan thought to himself and said, "Then I won't be polite!"
"Slow down." Wei Qingshan stopped him and said doubtfully: "Little friend, you... don't want to use acupuncture to treat patients, do you?"
"Any questions?"
"It's more than just a problem, it's simply ridiculous! Hey, didn't your master tell you that acupuncture can only be used as an auxiliary treatment, how can it be used as a primary treatment in such a big way?"
Wei Qingshan's eyes flashed with disappointment and he shook his head. This was completely contrary to his knowledge.
"Mr. Wei has been practicing medicine for more than sixty years and has saved countless lives. His experience is not comparable to yours, so stop fooling around." Chu Haishan also frowned seriously. In his opinion, Ning Xiaofan was not very knowledgeable.
"Acupuncture cannot be used for primary treatment?" Ning Xiaofan raised his eyebrows and said coldly and proudly: "Then I will show you the power of acupuncture today!"
After saying that, he raised his right hand in the air, and the tumbling air magically lifted up a silver needle of ice from the bottom of the box.
The next moment, Ning Xiaofan flicked his finger like a freehand stroke, and the silver needle hit his fingertip, turning into an icy blue stream of light that hit Chu Xiyan right between the eyebrows.
"You are looking for death!!"
When Chu Haishan saw Ning Xiaofan being so presumptuous, his eyes suddenly became fierce.
"It's amazing! It's amazing!"
At this moment, Wei Qingshan shouted in surprise, his eyes filled with fear.
Chu Haishan turned around and saw Chu Xiyan coughing violently on the bed. A large amount of black blood was coughed out from her mouth and nose, soaking the sheets.
"Xiyan!"
Chu Haishan looked ecstatic, like a gust of wind blowing to the bedside, hugging Chu Xiyan tightly, with hot tears flowing from his eyes.
"That's great, Xiyan, my daughter... you're okay!"
"Dad...what's wrong with me?"
Chu Xiyan looked pale and weak.
"It was Ning Xiaofan who saved you!" Suddenly, Chu Haishan looked ashamed. He seemed to have been scolding others just now.
"Xiaofan?"
Surprise flashed in Chu Xiyan's eyes. She raised her head and saw Ning Xiaofan and an energetic old man standing beside the bed.
"Hey, Chu University beauty, how are you feeling now?"
Ning Xiaofan asked with a smile.
"It feels a little uncomfortable, but it's much better... Ning Xiaofan, did you really save me?" Chu Xiyan looked at him in disbelief.
"Haishan, you are really lucky to meet Xiaoyou Ning..."
Wei Qingshan smiled self-deprecatingly, "My old man has seen such uncanny acupuncture techniques today. Even compared to the medical sage on Heshan Mountain in Zhonghai, I'm afraid he can't give in!"
"Forgive me for asking, little friend Ning, from whom did you learn this magic needle?"
"My master travels all over the world all the year round. It's okay not to mention the dragon's tail but not its head." Ning Xiaofan said randomly.
"This is the master."
Wei Qingshan was obviously frightened.
At this moment, Chu Xiyan suddenly let out a scream!
"Ah! You...who are you?!"
The three of them were shocked when they saw Chu Xiyan lying on the hospital bed, her jade finger pointed at the window sill, as if she had seen something extremely terrifying, and her face was as white as tissue paper with fright.
"Xiyan! Xiyan, what's wrong with you?"
Chu Haishan hurriedly stepped forward to hug his daughter, and turned around to look. There was nothing on the window sill except curtains and potted plants, but Chu Xiyan was so frightened that she screamed.
"Mr. Wei, Xiaofan, Xiyan, this is..." Chu Haishan's nerves that had just relaxed became tense again.
Wei Qingshan also looked confused. He thought to himself: Could it be that Ning Xiaofan used too much force during acupuncture just now and damaged the person's head?
Ning Xiaofan frowned. After thinking for a while, he stepped forward, gripped the curtain tightly, and tore it apart with all his strength.
A corner of the white curtain was torn off. Ning Xiaofan took it to the pool and soaked it. He bit his index finger and wrote something on the white cloth...
Wei Qingshan and Chu Haishan looked at each other, neither of them knew what Ning Xiaofan was doing.
"Eye of Heaven, open!"
Ning Xiaofan threw the white cloth in the air, pinched the sword finger with his right hand, and pointed it from a distance!
next scene, the two of them were immediately frightened to death!
I saw an old lady in white clothes and a white hat sitting there by the originally empty window sill, with a sharp mouth and monkey cheeks, as if she had emerged from the air, looking at the few people with evil eyes.
The old lady in white clothes was full of evil aura, and her eyes were extremely sinister. Just one look at her made her feel like she had fallen into an ice cellar.
"Ghost!!"
Chu Haishan was the first to shout. As the chairman of a large group in charge of tens of billions of wealth, he had never seen such a terrifying scene.
Wei Qingshan was so frightened that his face turned pale and he didn't dare to move.
Only Ning Xiaofan looked at the old lady in white calmly.
"Jie, Jie, Jie, I never thought that you, a little baby, could actually open your heavenly eyes... I know quite a lot of the seventy-two channels of Taoism. Which channel do you follow?"
The voice of the old lady in white was dull and hoarse, as unpleasant as ground glass.
"Huang Santai?"
Hearing the other party's call, Ning Xiaofan felt a chill in his heart. It's over now, he's in big trouble!
"Jie Jie, if you don't tell me, grandma won't bother to ask."
Mrs. Huang Santai sneered: "But this matter is a grudge between me and the Chu family. I advise you not to get involved...
